label: Every tab is a saved view
caption: One data-ui <data-views> over the 212 trajectories with its <data-facets> rail: Dataset first, Split under it. The tabs are data-ui's own view tabs; each dashboard is a preset of the proposed type: panels, its panels drawn from the rows the rail leaves. One gear in the bar sets the colours for every tab.

label: Tick two datasets and holdout: every panel recounts
caption: Cell · Conveyor PnP and UR5e alone · Workspace, then holdout: 16 + 12 = 28 trajectories. Split applies to both datasets ticked. The pill row says what is filtered, the strip says which rows (dots in each dataset's colour) and that every figure is re-aggregated from them.

label: Switch tabs: the filter holds; the joint picker is this tab's own
caption: One joint, still the same 28: the joint picker is the dashboard's own control (vars: in its view entry, ${joint} in its panels), drawn on this tab only, and Save view keeps the pick. Status line, pills and strip all still say 28.

label: + makes your own dashboard tab
caption: data-ui's own + offers Dashboard (view-types: panels, table, chart). A new dashboard starts with every panel of the file's dashboards on offer; two picks later it is a tab like the others (a user view in this browser, • on its tab), over the same 28 trajectories.

label: Drill into one trajectory, open it in Rerun
caption: Trajectories is a stock data-ui table preset beside the dashboards (dataset and split badges, a header click sorts). A row opens data-ui's record pane: what this trajectory adds, and Open in Rerun posting its rrd.
